entries.title: Corrected WBC count (nucleated RBCs)
entries.formula: Corrected WBC = measured WBC x 100 / (100 + nRBC per 100 WBC)
entries.caveat: Applies when nRBCs are reported per 100 WBC on differential.

entries.title: BUN/creatinine ratio
entries.caveat: Reference intervals vary by laboratory and population; interpret with clinical context.
entries.reference: Tietz Textbook of Clinical Chemistry, 6th ed.

entries.title: Reticulocyte production index (RPI)
entries.formula: RPI = (retic % x patient Hct / normal Hct) / maturation correction
entries.caveat: Maturation correction depends on the degree of anemia (e.g., 1.5 at Hct 30-35%).

entries.title: Anion gap
entries.caveat: Use the reference interval of your local laboratory and method.
entries.reference: Tietz Textbook of Clinical Chemistry, 6th ed.
